prompt: A unified team competed in the 1992 Summer Olympic games. How many years old was the first leader of the largest member nation of that team at the time of the game?
answer: The Unified Team’s largest member was **Russia**. Its first post-Soviet leader was **Boris Yeltsin**, born February 1, 1931. During the 1992 Summer Olympics (July 25–August 9), he was **61 years old**.
